entities.summary: Demarquis Dangelo "Dee" Bost is an American-born naturalized Bulgarian professional basketball player for the Al-Rayyan of the Qatari Basketball League. He also represents the Bulgarian national team internationally. He played college basketball for the Mississippi State Bulldogs.
